package observer_test

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "sort"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/baselineobservation"
)

type profileBarrier struct {
 Name string `json:"name"`
 Joined bool `json:"joined"`
 Error *string `json:"error"`
}

// This is report validation, not acquisition evidence. Only the composed
// public Models fixture may populate witnesses used for completeness.
type profileCapacityWitness struct {
 Origin string `json:"origin"`
 Scenario string `json:"scenario,omitempty"`
 SessionID string `json:"factorySessionID"`
 ScopeID string `json:"scopeID"`
 ModelName string `json:"modelName"`
 OwnerIdentity string `json:"ownerIdentity"`
 Slot string `json:"slot"`
 Holders int `json:"holders"`
 PublicCapacity int `json:"publicCapacity"`
 InvocationIDs []string `json:"invocationIDs"`
 LeaseIDs []string `json:"leaseIDs"`
 Released bool `json:"releasedUnderOwnerPolicy"`
 Multiplicity string `json:"multiplicityDisposition"`
 Checkpoints []profileCheckpoint `json:"checkpoints"`
}

func validateProfileCapacityWitness(w profileCapacityWitness) error {
 if w.Origin!="composed_public_models" || w.SessionID=="" || w.ScopeID=="" || w.ModelName=="" || w.OwnerIdentity=="" || w.Slot=="" {
  return fmt.Errorf("missing composed public Models attribution")
 }
 if w.Holders<1 || w.PublicCapacity<1 || w.Holders>w.PublicCapacity || !w.Released {
  return fmt.Errorf("missing capacity or owner-policy release")
 }
 if w.Slot!=w.ScopeID+"|"+strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(w.ModelName)){return fmt.Errorf("slot scope/model attribution mismatch")}
 if w.PublicCapacity>1 && (w.Holders<2 || w.Multiplicity!="exercised") || w.PublicCapacity==1 && (w.Holders!=1 || w.Multiplicity!="public_capacity_one") {
  return fmt.Errorf("public multiplicity not exercised")
 }
 for _,ids:=range [][]string{w.InvocationIDs,w.LeaseIDs} {
  seen:=map[string]bool{}
  if len(ids)!=w.Holders{return fmt.Errorf("holder identities do not match multiplicity")}
  for _,id:=range ids{if id=="" || seen[id]{return fmt.Errorf("empty or duplicate holder identity")};seen[id]=true}
 }
 if len(w.Checkpoints)!=2{return fmt.Errorf("capacity active/released checkpoints required")}
 for index,c:=range w.Checkpoints {
  stage:="CAPACITY_ACTIVE";if index==1{stage="CAPACITY_RELEASED"}
  if c.Stage!=stage || c.Report.FactorySessionID==nil || *c.Report.FactorySessionID!=w.SessionID || len(c.Report.RuntimeGenerationIDs)==0 {
   return fmt.Errorf("capacity checkpoint lifecycle attribution mismatch")
  }
  if err:=validateReport(c.Report);err!=nil{return err}
  if len(c.Barriers)==0{return fmt.Errorf("missing capacity checkpoint barrier")}
  for _,b:=range c.Barriers{if b.Name=="" || !b.Joined || b.Error!=nil{return fmt.Errorf("failed capacity checkpoint barrier")}}
  var leases *baselineobservation.LeaseSnapshot
  for _,owner:=range c.Report.Owners{if owner.OwnerIdentity==w.OwnerIdentity && owner.Kind=="models_leases"{leases=owner.Leases}}
  if leases==nil{return fmt.Errorf("capacity owner unavailable")}
  expected:=w.Holders;if index==1{expected=0}
  if leases.CapacityHolders[w.Slot]!=expected{return fmt.Errorf("capacity slot multiplicity mismatch")}
  for _,id:=range w.LeaseIDs {
   matches:=0
   for _,record:=range leases.LeaseRecords {
    if record.Key!=id{continue};matches++
    if record.Scope!=w.ScopeID || record.ModelName!=w.ModelName{return fmt.Errorf("lease scope/model attribution mismatch")}
    // Existing owner policy retains the claimed flag after release/expiry.
    if index==0 && (record.Status!="ACTIVE" || !record.Claimed) || index==1 && record.Status!="RELEASED" && record.Status!="EXPIRED"{return fmt.Errorf("lease disposition mismatch")}
   }
   if matches!=1{return fmt.Errorf("missing or duplicate retained lease identity")}
  }
 }
 active,released:=w.Checkpoints[0].Report,w.Checkpoints[1].Report
 if active.Artifact!=released.Artifact || active.FixtureScope!=released.FixtureScope || len(active.RuntimeGenerationIDs)!=len(released.RuntimeGenerationIDs){return fmt.Errorf("capacity checkpoint identity changed")}
 for i,id:=range active.RuntimeGenerationIDs{if id=="" || id!=released.RuntimeGenerationIDs[i]{return fmt.Errorf("capacity runtime generation changed")}}
 return nil
}

func validProfileCapacityWitness()profileCapacityWitness {
  session:="session"
  checkpoints:=[]profileCheckpoint{}
  for i,stage:=range []string{"CAPACITY_ACTIVE","CAPACITY_RELEASED"} {
   report:=validObserverReport();report.FactorySessionID=&session;report.RuntimeGenerationIDs=[]string{"generation"}
   owner:=report.Owners[0].Leases
   owner.LeaseRecords=[]baselineobservation.LeaseRecord{}
   for _,id:=range []string{"lease-1","lease-2"}{status:="ACTIVE";if i==1{status="RELEASED"};owner.LeaseRecords=append(owner.LeaseRecords,baselineobservation.LeaseRecord{Key:id,Scope:"scope",ModelName:"model",Status:status,Claimed:true})}
   owner.LeaseRecordCount=2;report.Totals.LeaseRecordCount=2
   owner.CapacityHolders=map[string]int{"scope|MODEL":2}
   if i==1{owner.CapacityHolders=map[string]int{};owner.CapacityHoldersTotal=0;report.Totals.CapacityHoldersTotal=0}
   checkpoints=append(checkpoints,profileCheckpoint{Report:report,Stage:stage,Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"controlled gate / joined invocation",Joined:true}}})
  }
  return profileCapacityWitness{Origin:"composed_public_models",SessionID:session,ScopeID:"scope",ModelName:"model",OwnerIdentity:"leases",Slot:"scope|MODEL",Holders:2,PublicCapacity:2,InvocationIDs:[]string{"work-1","work-2"},LeaseIDs:[]string{"lease-1","lease-2"},Released:true,Multiplicity:"exercised",Checkpoints:checkpoints}
 }

func TestLifecycleProfileReportCapacityAttribution(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 fresh:=validProfileCapacityWitness
 if err:=validateProfileCapacityWitness(fresh());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 cases:=map[string]func(*profileCapacityWitness){
  "synthetic":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Origin="synthetic_calibration"},
  "empty activity":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Holders=0},
  "missing owner":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.OwnerIdentity="absent"},
  "wrong slot":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Slot="other"},
  "capacity exceeded":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.PublicCapacity=1},
  "claimed release":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Released=false},
  "nil identities":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.InvocationIDs=nil},
  "duplicate invocations":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.InvocationIDs[1]=w.InvocationIDs[0]},
  "duplicate leases":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.LeaseIDs[1]=w.LeaseIDs[0]},
  "missing lease":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.LeaseIDs[1]="absent"},
  "wrong scope":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.ScopeID="peer"},
  "wrong model":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.ModelName="peer"},
  "missing checkpoint":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints=w.Checkpoints[:1]},
  "failed join":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[1].Barriers[0].Joined=false},
  "missing barrier":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[1].Barriers=nil},
  "missing inventory":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[1].Report.OwnerInventoryComplete=false},
  "wrong session":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.SessionID="peer"},
  "unclaimed active":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[0].Report.Owners[0].Leases.LeaseRecords[0].Claimed=false},
  "erased retained record":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[1].Report.Owners[0].Leases.LeaseRecords=w.Checkpoints[1].Report.Owners[0].Leases.LeaseRecords[:1];w.Checkpoints[1].Report.Owners[0].Leases.LeaseRecordCount=1;w.Checkpoints[1].Report.Totals.LeaseRecordCount=1},
  "changed artifact":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[1].Report.Artifact.SourceCommit="peer"},
  "changed generation":func(w *profileCapacityWitness){w.Checkpoints[1].Report.RuntimeGenerationIDs[0]="peer"},
 }
 for name,change:=range cases{t.Run(name,func(t *testing.T){w:=fresh();change(&w);if validateProfileCapacityWitness(w)==nil{t.Fatal("invalid capacity accepted")}})}
 w:=fresh();w.Checkpoints[1].Report.Owners[0].Leases.LeaseRecords[0].Status="EXPIRED"
 if err:=validateProfileCapacityWitness(w);err!=nil{t.Fatal("honest expired record rejected",err)}
 before,err:=json.Marshal(w);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=validateProfileCapacityWitness(w);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 after,err:=json.Marshal(w);if err!=nil || string(before)!=string(after){t.Fatal("validation mutated detached observation")}
}
type profileCheckpoint struct {
 Report checkpointReport
 Stage string
 Barriers []profileBarrier
}
func (c profileCheckpoint) MarshalJSON() ([]byte,error) {
 data,err:=json.Marshal(c.Report); if err!=nil{return nil,err}
 var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
 if err=json.Unmarshal(data,&fields); err!=nil{return nil,err}
 delete(fields,"checkpoint")
 fields["stage"],err=json.Marshal(c.Stage); if err!=nil{return nil,err}
 fields["barriers"],err=json.Marshal(c.Barriers); if err!=nil{return nil,err}
 return json.Marshal(fields)
}
type profileAttempt struct {
 ID string `json:"attemptID"`
 Kind string `json:"kind"`
 Ordinal int `json:"ordinal"`
 SessionID *string `json:"factorySessionID"`
 Generations []string `json:"runtimeGenerationIDs"`
 Duration *int64 `json:"durationNs"`
 Valid bool `json:"valid"`
 Noise []string `json:"noise"`
 Errors []string `json:"errors"`
 Barriers []profileBarrier `json:"barriers"`
 Checkpoints []profileCheckpoint `json:"checkpoints"`
}
type profileSummary struct {
 ValidCount int `json:"validCount"`
 AttemptCount int `json:"attemptCount"`
 Median *float64 `json:"medianNs"`
 P95 *int64 `json:"p95Ns"`
 Min *int64 `json:"minNs"`
 Max *int64 `json:"maxNs"`
}
func summarizeProfile(attempts []profileAttempt, kind string, measured bool) profileSummary {
 s:=profileSummary{}; values:=[]int64{}
 for _,a:=range attempts {
  if a.Kind!=kind {continue}; s.AttemptCount++
  if a.Valid && a.Duration!=nil {s.ValidCount++; values=append(values,*a.Duration)}
 }
 if !measured || len(values)==0 {return s}
 sort.Slice(values,func(i,j int)bool{return values[i]<values[j]})
 n:=len(values); median:=float64(values[n/2])
 if n%2==0 {median=float64(values[n/2-1])/2+float64(values[n/2])/2}
 p95:=values[(95*n+99)/100-1]; lo,hi:=values[0],values[n-1]
 s.Median=&median;s.P95=&p95;s.Min=&lo;s.Max=&hi
 return s
}
func validateProfileAttempt(a profileAttempt) error {
 if a.ID=="" || a.Ordinal<1 || (a.Kind!="inert" && a.Kind!="session") {return fmt.Errorf("invalid attempt identity")}
 if a.Generations==nil || a.Noise==nil || a.Errors==nil || a.Barriers==nil || a.Checkpoints==nil {return fmt.Errorf("known empty collections must be arrays")}
 if !a.Valid {return nil} // Failed raw attempts remain reportable, never count as valid.
 if a.Duration==nil || *a.Duration<0 || len(a.Errors)>0 || len(a.Barriers)==0 || len(a.Checkpoints)==0 {return fmt.Errorf("invalid successful attempt")}
 for _,b:=range a.Barriers {if b.Name=="" || !b.Joined || b.Error!=nil{return fmt.Errorf("unjoined barrier")}}
 for _,c:=range a.Checkpoints {
  if err:=validateReport(c.Report);err!=nil{return err}
  if c.Stage!="Q0" && c.Stage!="HOST_BASELINE" && c.Stage!="SAMPLE_CLOSED" && c.Stage!="Q2" {return fmt.Errorf("unsupported sample checkpoint")}
  if len(c.Barriers)==0 {return fmt.Errorf("missing checkpoint barrier")}
  for _,b:=range c.Barriers {if b.Name=="" || !b.Joined || b.Error!=nil{return fmt.Errorf("failed checkpoint barrier")}}
 }
 if a.Kind=="session" && (a.SessionID==nil || *a.SessionID=="" || len(a.Generations)==0) {return fmt.Errorf("missing explicit session attribution")}
 return nil
}
func TestLifecycleProfileReportStatistics(t *testing.T) {
 attempts:=[]profileAttempt{}
 for i:=int64(10);i>=1;i-- {v:=i;attempts=append(attempts,profileAttempt{Kind:"inert",Duration:&v,Valid:true})}
 failed:=int64(900);attempts=append(attempts,profileAttempt{Kind:"inert",Duration:&failed})
 s:=summarizeProfile(attempts,"inert",true)
 if s.ValidCount!=10 || s.AttemptCount!=11 || *s.Median!=5.5 || *s.P95!=10 || *s.Min!=1 || *s.Max!=10 {t.Fatalf("statistics: %#v",s)}
 if summarizeProfile(attempts,"inert",false).Median!=nil {t.Fatal("capability must not publish timing statistics")}
 // A noisy valid outlier remains part of the full observed range.
 attempts[0].Duration=&failed;attempts[0].Noise=[]string{"shared host saturation"}
 s=summarizeProfile(attempts,"inert",true)
 if *s.Max!=900 || *s.P95!=900 {t.Fatal("noisy valid sample was removed")}
}
func TestLifecycleProfileReportRejectsInvalidSuccess(t *testing.T) {
 duration:=int64(1)
 valid:=func()profileAttempt{return profileAttempt{ID:"inert-1",Kind:"inert",Ordinal:1,Duration:&duration,Valid:true,
 Generations:[]string{},Noise:[]string{},Errors:[]string{},Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"Close",Joined:true}},
 Checkpoints:[]profileCheckpoint{{Report:validObserverReport(),Stage:"SAMPLE_CLOSED",Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"closed",Joined:true}}}}}}
 if err:=validateProfileAttempt(valid());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 cases:=[]func(*profileAttempt){
  func(a *profileAttempt){a.Noise=nil},func(a *profileAttempt){a.Barriers[0].Joined=false},
  func(a *profileAttempt){a.Checkpoints[0].Report.OwnerInventoryComplete=false},
  func(a *profileAttempt){a.Errors=append(a.Errors,"cleanup failed")},
  func(a *profileAttempt){a.Kind="session"},func(a *profileAttempt){a.Duration=nil},
 }
 for i,change:=range cases {a:=valid();change(&a);if validateProfileAttempt(a)==nil{t.Errorf("accepted invalid case %d",i)}}
}
